description: Discover available attributes (standard/custom) for a resource. Never alter schema or create fields. Requires resource_type; optional categories selects subsets. For select/status attributes, use get_record_attribute_options to fetch valid values before creating or updating records.

resource_type.description: Type of resource to operate on. Standard types: companies, people, deals, tasks, lists, records, notes. Custom objects (e.g., "funds", "investment_opportunities") are also supported after running `attio-discover attributes -a`.

name: discover_record_attributes
